Not Too Shabby is UCB’s long-running sketch open mic night every Sunday at 7pm at the UCB Annex on Bronson. Sketches! Characters! Bits! Songs! Come see future comedy stars of tomorrow try out new material with reckless abandon! Hosted by Public Breakup: Milan Anderson, Dani Bryan, Elizabeth Conway, Sarah Kylie, Christan Leonard, Jesse McIntosh, Ezra Parter, Sam Sibilsky Want to perform? Submissions open on the day of the show. Raffle style! We will contact you if you’ve been picked. We do a Google form – but if people have questions they can email [email protected] or hit us up on Instagram @nottooshabbyucb ! — Under 17 must be accompanied by a parent/guardian. Please use discretion, as all our shows can potentially use adult/sexual material, language, and images.
